name: Deformed element ray intersection
aliases: Wiley et al. method for deformed quadratic tetrahedra
definition: A method to determine ray segments intersecting deformed finite elements, where the mapping from standard element shape to physical space is non-linear.
summary: Deformed element ray intersection determines ray segments within non-linear finite elements, distinct from linear methods by handling higher-order polynomial mappings and requiring approximate inverse mapping for scalar evaluation.
